advancements.meridian.root.title: Meridian
advancements.meridian.root.description: Collect any Meridian shelf to start shaping your enchanting stats.
advancements.meridian.stone_tier.title: Stone Foundations
advancements.meridian.stone_tier.descrip: Craft a Hellshelf, Seashelf, or Dormant Deepshelf to begin Eterna progression.
advancements.meridian.tier_three.title: Infused Mastery
advancements.meridian.tier_three.descrip: Craft an Infused Hellshelf, Infused Seashelf, or Deepshelf through the stat-gated table.
advancements.meridian.library.title: The Enchantment Library
advancements.meridian.library.descriptio: Craft an Enchantment Library to pool enchanted books by level.
advancements.meridian.ender_library.desc: Upgrade the Library to a Library of Alexandria at the enchanting table.
advancements.meridian.tome_apprentice.de: Craft a Scrap Tome to salvage enchantments from any tool or weapon.
advancements.meridian.tome_master.title: Tome Master
advancements.meridian.tome_master.descri: Craft an Extraction Tome to pull every enchantment without destroying the item.
advancements.meridian.warden_tendril.des: Claim a Warden Tendril from the depths — required for sculk-tier shelves.
advancements.meridian.infused_breath.des: Refine Dragon's Breath into Infused Breath at a high-Eterna table.
advancements.meridian.apotheosis.title: Apotheosis
advancements.meridian.apotheosis.descrip: Reach maximum enchanting power — hit Eterna 50 and take the top-slot enchant.
advancements.meridian.sculk_mastery.desc: Craft an Echoing or Soul-Touched Sculkshelf — the pinnacle of enchanting power.
Craft a Rectifier shelf to gain control over enchantment stability.
advancements.meridian.all_seeing.title: All-Seeing
advancements.meridian.all_seeing.descrip: Craft a Hellshelf of Masterful Sight to reveal all enchantment clues.
advancements.meridian.curator.title: The Curator
advancements.meridian.curator.descriptio: Craft a Filtering Shelf to blacklist unwanted enchantments from your table.
advancements.meridian.treasure_seeker.de: Craft a Deepshelf of Arcane Treasures to unlock treasure-tier enchantments at the table.
advancements.meridian.web_spinner.title: Web Spinner
advancements.meridian.web_spinner.descri: Obtain a Prismatic Web — the key to removing curses from enchanted gear.
advancements.meridian.high_quanta.title: Chaotic Enchanter
advancements.meridian.high_quanta.descri: Enchant an item with Quanta above 60 — embrace the chaos.
advancements.meridian.high_arcana.title: Arcane Scholar
advancements.meridian.high_arcana.descri: Enchant an item with Arcana above 60 — command the rarest enchantments.
advancements.meridian.high_rectification: Enchant an item with Rectification above 60 — tame the volatility of your rolls.
advancements.meridian.high_clues.title: The Full Picture
advancements.meridian.high_clues.descrip: Enchant an item with a Clues stat of 8 or more — leave nothing to chance.
advancements.meridian.library_deposit.de: Deposit an enchanted book into the Enchantment Library's pool.
advancements.meridian.library_extract.de: Withdraw an enchanted book from the Library, drawing on its pooled levels.
advancements.meridian.filtering_blacklis: Shelve a book in the Filtering Shelf to blacklist its enchantment from your table.
advancements.meridian.tome_salvage.title: Salvage Rites
advancements.meridian.tome_salvage.descr: Use a salvage tome in the anvil to pull an enchantment onto a book.
advancements.meridian.curse_strip.title: Breaking the Curse
advancements.meridian.curse_strip.descri: Strip a curse from your gear with a Prismatic Web in the anvil.
advancements.meridian.tempered_core.desc: Make an item permanently unbreakable with a Tempered Core in the anvil.
config.meridian.title: Meridian Configuration
config.meridian.enchantingTable.allowTre: Allow treasure enchantments without a Deepshelf of Arcane Treasures.
config.meridian.shelves.sculkShelfShriek: Chance for Sculk shelves to trigger a shrieker (0.0–1.0).
config.meridian.shelves.sculkParticleCha: Particle spawn rate for Sculk shelves (0.0–1.0).
config.meridian.anvil.prismaticWebLevelC: XP levels consumed per curse removal.
config.meridian.anvil.temperedCoreEnable: Enable applying a Tempered Core at the anvil to make gear unbreakable.
config.meridian.anvil.temperedCoreLevelC: XP levels consumed to apply a Tempered Core.
config.meridian.library.ioRateLimitTicks: Hopper insert throttle in ticks (0 = no limit).
config.meridian.tomes.scrapTomeXpCost.to: XP levels for Scrap Tome use.
config.meridian.tomes.improvedScrapTomeX: XP levels for Improved Scrap Tome use.
config.meridian.tomes.extractionTomeXpCo: XP levels for Extraction Tome use.
config.meridian.tomes.extractionTomeItem: Durability damage to source item from Extraction Tome.
config.meridian.tomes.extractionTomeRepa: Percent of max durability restored after extraction (0.0–1.0).
config.meridian.tableCrafting.allowDupli: Allow the vanilla-item duplication recipes at the enchanting table (totem of undying, echo shard, golden apples, golden carrot, heart of the sea, budding amethyst). Disabled recipes vanish from the table and from EMI/REI/JEI; in multiplayer the server's value governs all clients.
config.meridian.everfeast.enabled.toolti: Allow the Everfeast ration and Everfull Flask recipes at the enchanting table. Disabled recipes vanish from the table and from EMI/REI/JEI; already-crafted Everfeast items keep working. In multiplayer the server's value governs all clients.
config.meridian.everfeast.bites.tooltip: Bites a newly-infused Everfeast Ration holds (1–4096); existing rations keep the count they were made with.
config.meridian.warden.tendrilLootingBon: Additional drop chance per Looting level (0.0–1.0).
config.meridian.groom.chanceLevel1.toolt: Chance that a Groom I brush of a farm animal yields its renewable drop (0.0–1.0).
config.meridian.groom.chanceLevel2.toolt: Chance that a Groom II brush of a farm animal yields its renewable drop (0.0–1.0).
config.meridian.groom.cooldownTicks.tool: Ticks an animal stays on cooldown after a groom attempt, so a pen can't be farmed continuously.
config.meridian.combat.sunderAffectsPlay: Allow the Sunder enchantment to knock equipment off player victims; mobs are always eligible.
config.meridian.combat.seekerTargetsPlay: Allow Seeker bolts to lock onto player targets; mobs are always eligible.
config.meridian.combat.harpoonAffectsPla: Allow the Harpoon enchantment to drag player victims toward the thrower; mobs are always eligible.
config.meridian.combat.undertowAffectsPl: Allow the Undertow enchantment to gather player victims toward the impact point; mobs are always eligible.
config.meridian.combat.markAffectsPlayer: Allow the Mark enchantment to make struck players glow through walls; mobs are always eligible.
config.meridian.combat.pinAffectsPlayers: Allow the Pin enchantment to root player victims in place; mobs are always eligible.
config.meridian.combat.staggerAffectsPla: Allow a Stagger shield block to daze player attackers with slowness and weakness; mobs are always eligible.
config.meridian.combat.bullrushAffectsPl: Allow a Bullrush shield charge to knock back and daze player victims; mobs are always eligible.
config.meridian.combat.trackersLensAffec: Allow the Tracker's Lens enchantment to mark players to glow through walls; mobs are always eligible.
config.meridian.attunement.radius.toolti: Blocks from a qualifying enchanting table within which Attunement gear repairs (1–32).
config.meridian.attunement.intervalTicks: Server ticks between repair pulses; each pulse repairs durability equal to the Attunement level per item (20–1200).
config.meridian.attunement.minEterna.too: Minimum shelf-scan Eterna a table needs to count as an enchanting setup (0–100).
config.meridian.display.overLeveledColor: Hex color for over-leveled enchantment display.
config.meridian.display.enableInlineEnch: Show inline enchantment descriptions in tooltips.
gui.meridian.enchant_info.title: Available Enchantments
gui.meridian.stat.eterna.formula: Each point of Eterna raises the max enchanting level by 2
gui.meridian.stat.quanta.formula: Quanta %% is the most the level can randomly swing up or down
gui.meridian.stat.arcana.desc3: and increases the number of enchantments
gui.meridian.stat.arcana.formula: Higher Arcana skews the odds toward rarer enchantments and can guarantee extra ones
info.meridian.prismatic_web: Can be used to remove curses in an anvil.
info.meridian.infused_breath: Crafting material for endgame shelves and libraries.
info.meridian.dormant_core: Inert, wrested from a slain Ender Dragon. A sufficiently powerful enchanting table might ignite it.
info.meridian.tempered_core: Combine with a tool or armor piece in an anvil to make it unbreakable.
info.meridian.everfeast: An infused ration that feeds you many times over.
info.meridian.scrap_tome: Extracts one random enchantment from an item.
info.meridian.scrap_tome2: Destroys the item in the process.
info.meridian.scrap_tome3: Combine with an enchanted item in an anvil.
info.meridian.improved_scrap_tome: Extracts all enchantments from an item.
info.meridian.improved_scrap_tome2: Destroys the item in the process.
info.meridian.improved_scrap_tome3: Combine with an enchanted item in an anvil.
info.meridian.extraction_tome: Extracts all enchantments from an item.
info.meridian.extraction_tome3: Combine with an enchanted item in an anvil.
info.meridian.iron_block_repair: Combine with a damaged or chipped anvil to repair it one tier.
info.meridian.dormant_xp_tome: Activate at the enchanting table to store experience.
message.meridian.enchlib.not_enough_poin: Not enough points stored for that level.
message.meridian.enchlib.level_locked: That level isn't available from this library.
info.meridian.beeshelf: Trades enchanting level for maximum chaos — levels can swing wildly either way.
info.meridian.melonshelf: Calms the table: reduces the random level swing at a small cost to enchanting level.
info.meridian.stoneshelf: Dampens the table, lowering enchanting level and making rare enchantments less likely.
info.meridian.hellshelf: A basic Nether shelf that raises the max enchanting level, with a touch of chaos.
info.meridian.blazing_hellshelf: A potent Nether shelf pushing enchanting level high, but it hides one clue.
info.meridian.glowing_hellshelf: A refined Nether shelf that raises the enchanting level and nudges the odds toward rarer enchantments.
info.meridian.infused_hellshelf: An infused Nether shelf offering steady enchanting level with mild chaos.
info.meridian.seashelf: A basic ocean shelf that raises the max enchanting level and slightly favors rarer enchantments.
info.meridian.heart_seashelf: An ocean shelf that strongly favors rarer enchantments, at a small cost to stability.
info.meridian.crystal_seashelf: A balanced ocean shelf: enchanting level, a little chaos, and rarer enchantments.
info.meridian.infused_seashelf: An infused ocean shelf offering steady enchanting level and rarer enchantments, with no added chaos.
info.meridian.endshelf: An End shelf that supports high enchanting levels with modest chaos and rarity bonuses.
info.meridian.pearl_endshelf: A pearl-studded End shelf granting strong enchanting level, chaos, and rarity all at once.
info.meridian.draconic_endshelf: The pinnacle of raw power: a huge enchanting level boost with no chaos at all.
info.meridian.deepshelf: A deep-dark shelf granting solid enchanting level and a lean toward rarer enchantments.
info.meridian.dormant_deepshelf: A sleeping deep-dark shelf with a faint enchanting level bonus. It could be awakened.
info.meridian.echoing_deepshelf: An awakened deep-dark shelf that strongly favors rarer enchantments.
info.meridian.soul_touched_deepshelf: An awakened deep-dark shelf that adds a heavy dose of chaos.
info.meridian.echoing_sculkshelf: A sculk shelf strongly favoring rarer enchantments; reveals one clue.
info.meridian.soul_touched_sculkshelf: A sculk shelf of high enchanting level and chaos, with a touch of Rectification.
info.meridian.sightshelf: Reveals one enchantment clue, showing part of what the table will actually give you.
info.meridian.sightshelf_t2: Reveals two enchantment clues, showing more of what the table will actually give you.
info.meridian.rectifier: Steers chaos upward: random level swings become a bit more likely to help than hurt.
info.meridian.rectifier_t2: A stronger rectifier — random level swings lean further in your favor.
info.meridian.rectifier_t3: A master rectifier — random level swings lean strongly in your favor.
info.meridian.filtering_shelf: Insert single-enchantment enchanted books to prevent those enchantments from appearing in the enchanting table.
info.meridian.filtering_shelf2: Gains bonus Eterna and Arcana for each inserted book.
death.attack.meridian.corrupted: %1$s was consumed by a corrupted enchantment
enchantment.meridian.tempo.desc: Increases attack speed, allowing faster strikes
enchantment.meridian.bulwark.desc: Adds knockback resistance, keeping you grounded under fire

enchantment.meridian.ricochet.desc: Arrows bounce off surfaces instead of breaking

enchantment.meridian.seismic_slam.desc: Crouch-slamming releases a shockwave that damages nearby foes
enchantment.meridian.updraft.desc: Mace slams launch the wielder skyward for another strike

enchantment.meridian.stagger.desc: Blocking a melee hit dazes the attacker with slowness and weakness
enchantment.meridian.tailwind.desc: Firework rockets give a stronger, longer boost while gliding

enchantment.meridian.joust.desc: Melee damage scales with your mount's speed while riding
enchantment.meridian.tether.desc: Item stays in your inventory on death

enchantment.meridian.stormward.desc: Immune to lightning damage, and a nearby strike grants a burst of strength
enchantment.meridian.ballast.desc: Crouch to sink and hold jump to rise quickly underwater
enchantment.meridian.abyssal.desc: Reduces incoming damage the deeper you are below sea level
enchantment.meridian.reprieve.desc: Lengthens the respite after taking a hit before you can be hurt again
